[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Drayson''' was the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of [[Edan Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. He ordered the evacuation of the base after it was attacked by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.
